Wreck dives, vibrant reefs, and abundant marine life draw divers to the Red Sea year after year with MY Independence II.

Egypt offers more than just underwater wonders; it's a top destination for combining liveaboard diving with cultural tours. Explore world-famous historical sites like the Pyramids and Sphinx at Giza, Nile cruises, and the Valley of the Kings near Luxor.

The MY Independence II is the crown jewel of the Blue Water fleet, combining the elegance of a yacht with the spaciousness of a 40-meter vessel designed for just 20 guests. Its decks, covered in noble teak, offer ample space for sunbathing and relaxation, ensuring your dive safari is as luxurious and comfortable as any land-based hotel.

This stunning yacht is designed to deliver the perfect dive experience in the Red Sea. The MY Independence II stands out for its personalized service, exceptional accommodations, and meticulously planned itineraries that visit dive sites at the best times. Onboard, enjoy delicious buffet meals, prepared with care to keep you energized for the next dive.

The yacht offers two cabin types: twin bed and double bed. In your leisure time, you can enjoy audio-video entertainment and a well-stocked library, ensuring there's never a dull moment on board.
